mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the blood circuit to the lungs was most worthwhile: the result showed why blood flow alone cannot maintain oxygen transfer when the air is not renewed.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the pleural membranes felt less informative on its own. The result showed where they fit, but I wanted a clearer explanation of how the sealed fluid gap couples the lung to the chest.

surprise.text: The equal-volume comparison helped me understand why many small air sacs provide more surface area than one large space.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the item descriptions and results made the sequence plausible.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter. The constructions connected anatomy to function, especially when the results showed why exchange and renewed air are both needed.
